recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No follow-up source edit is needed for FHIR-16975 unless a future work group decision chooses to modernize Identifier wording beyond the already-applied clarification.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-core-datatypes change request asking to clarify Identifier's definition because "A technical identifier" could be confused with resource id and should instead indicate business identifiers.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied by c31e254aa7 (GF#16975 / svn 14290), which changed source/datatypes/identifier.xml from "A technical identifier - identifies some entity uniquely and unambiguously" to "An identifier - identifies some entity uniquely and unambiguously. Typically this is used for business identifiers".
additional_context: Identifier is an active datatype in source/fhir.ini and marked normative. Current source/datatypes.html describes Identifier as a string associated with a single object or entity within a given system and provides system/value uniqueness guidance. Later R5 datatype narrative work adjusted adjacent Identifier prose without restoring the confusing wording. Quoted Jira-neighborhood, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no related final issue or community discussion that changes this conclusion.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current authoritative Identifier XML and narrative already convey the requested clarification in current build scope.
